## Selected projects

- **Pledge management platform** (confidential — national religious institution). Java 11 / Spring Boot backend: 22 controllers, ~120 REST endpoints, 11 roles across a four-tier approval hierarchy. PostgreSQL on AWS RDS in two regions, 22 composite indexes added for dashboard performance. Angular console with 18 lazy-loaded modules. React Native client with offline drafting and reconnect sync. Integrations: S3, SES, Firebase Cloud Messaging, SMS gateway, SOAP identity directory. Authored the system's technical assessment and a target Linode/Cloudflare production architecture with automated pg_dump backups and a SonarQube + SAST gated GitLab CI/CD pipeline.
- **Legacy ASP.NET estate** (confidential — educational institution, Gujarat). Scoped an ongoing support retainer covering seven ASP.NET line-of-business applications (access control, HRMS, attendance, scheduling and meals, facility booking, payroll, entry/exit) on Windows Server and MS SQL. RCA-driven defect resolution, SQL index and backup maintenance, security patching, defined incident triage and escalation.
- **Happy Threads** — artisan e-commerce platform. Web and mobile system automating order routing to artisans by product type and geography, in-app accept/decline, QA tracking, and automatic artisan payment on approval.
- **Fresh Produce Daily** — supply chain automation. Automatic morning order aggregation across restaurant clients, vendor purchase-order generation, and tracked delivery routing.
- **Regional water distributor** — logistics automation. Structured order capture, zone-rule route assignment, staged notifications, digital delivery confirmation.
- **Mahad Al Zahra** — institutional software consulting. Process mapping, tool selection and guided implementation for student management, scheduling and administrative oversight.
- **Building Management System** (2019) — IoT system on Arduino and ESP8266 with Embedded C, Python and the BLYNK platform.
